data.esql:
FROM sloproof-ledger
| WHERE
    run_id == "demo-healthy-20260918-01" AND event == "verdict"
      AND actor == "deterministic-verifier"
| KEEP run_id, verdict, reason, contract_hash, @timestamp
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 2
